title: Let the sidebar recede
credit: Charlie Aufmann and Maxime Heckel · Linear
preserve: Smaller quiet glyphs, recognizable selection and enough row space to distinguish neighboring destinations.
test: Compare the same route and selection in each theme. Verify text contrast and the visible focus state.

title: Align like objects at each depth
preserve: The icon centers, label starts and trailing utilities each have a reference track. Nested items get a different inset.
test: Measure same-depth peers separately. Inspect the top-bar control centers and repeat with longer labels.

title: Keep the change readable on a phone
preserve: Guide title and sequence lead, compact filenames and signed change counts support the decision, and merge has its own space.
test: Load a long branch name and a pending check. Return to the same review step after inspecting a file.

title: Give an editorial statement room
preserve: A large, short serif statement, restrained sans-serif paragraph and wide dark image establish a reading sequence.
test: Read the actual title at two widths. Inspect its wrap and distance to the paragraph and photograph.

title: Keep an adjustable value in reading position
preserve: A persistent label occupies one end of a shallow track. The numerical value and unit share the opposite edge.
test: Drive the range to both limits and reverse. Read the underlying and displayed values and compare the value edge.

title: Carry a hint between neighboring tools
preserve: A small contrasting label travels with the active glyph while the strip keeps its position.
test: Move across the strip twice, reverse and dismiss. Verify the owner, visible hint, focus and settled placement.

title: Attach a status to its object
preserve: An edge ring separates the status disc from a detailed avatar and anchors it to the same person.
test: Switch status and inspect the actual accessible value and a non-color indication of the new state.

title: Use silhouette and secondary mass
preserve: A dark silhouette identifies the subject, while a second tone describes its interior or setting.
test: Compare equivalent glyphs at their real control size across normal, selected and disabled states.

title: Keep a selected passage readable
preserve: Local editing controls sit beside the passage. The result uses space beneath the original.
test: Select a middle sentence, then reject and accept changes. Check the range, neighboring text and toolbar clearance.

title: Put a proposed change beside its source
preserve: Connected records occupy the canvas while a localized proposal offers a decision point.
test: Inspect an original value, reject one proposal, accept another and verify which records changed.

title: Give a quiet empty state one way forward
preserve: The pale isometric drawing and blue detail sit above a specific search result and its recovery action.
test: Compare an empty collection with an unmatched query. Operate recovery without hover.

title: Move from properties to a plotted measure
preserve: Aligned plan values change into a chart section with a local selector. Lavender carries data while the action stays dark.
test: Try a long plan name, empty series and narrow plot. Verify units and series identity.

title: Vary the demonstration inside a stable slot
preserve: Distinct product imagery carries each tile while the captions share a reading track.
test: Inspect inactive, active and motion-reduced states. Verify caption placement and that the still communicates the feature.

title: Make a tactile deck interruptible
preserve: Photo and text cards overlap and rotate within the stage. The caption belongs to the stage and stays outside it.
test: Go forward twice and back before settling. Check the final object and active count.

title: Keep landmarks while the step changes shape
preserve: The segmented progress line and bottom action stay recognizable through illustration, summary and choice screens.
test: Navigate back with a long answer, short viewport and large text. Inspect retained input and the final line above the action.

title: Frame a product preview with a landscape
preserve: The centered headline and dark action lead into a light product sample. The mountain crosses the lower edge of the preview.
test: Check the crop at the narrowest intended width and verify that the preview’s useful detail and action survive.

title: Retune the artwork with the surface
preserve: The product begins with a slim navigation row and the artwork itself. Light mode shows a cluster of tilted image tiles; dark mode shows a HAUS editor preview. Short feature copy follows the art. The first two images isolate those product regions from the recording in the third.
test: Render both themes with the images loaded and inspect foreground detail, logo separation and text over art.
